hookups.source: Kandiyohi County 2026 Park Policy and Fees, 'Distribution of Camping Fees' (Green Lake County Park line 'Electricity / Sewer $9.20') + county parks page amenity table (Water column marked for Green Lake), read 2026-11-11; amperage not stated (derived 50 left alone)

sites.source: Kandiyohi County 2026 Park Policy and Fees III.11 ('Green Lake County Park 61') + county parks page ('Green Lake County Park has 61 campsites'); ResNexus lists 43 'Back-in', 16 'Back-In 90 day minimum' and 7 tent sites, read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2026 policy: reservations must be for 7 or more continuous days, except designated tent sites and before Memorial Day weekend / after Labor Day, when campsites may be rented by the day. Reservations online only (from January 20, 2026); seasonal campers get the first seven days. 16 back-in sites carry a 90-day minimum. No walk-up or first-come provision is stated. Read 2026-11-11.

booking.source: Kandiyohi County 2026 Park Policy and Fees I.1-3 ('Reservations must be for 7 or more continuous days, except for designated tenting camp sites and Pre-Memorial Day Weekend and Post Labor Day, campsites maybe rented by the day.'; 'Effective January 20th, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ONLY On-Line camping reservations will be taken on a first come, first serve basis.'; 'Seasonal Campers get the first seven days to register.') + ResNexus site types, read 2026-11-11

values.note: 2026: $42 a day plus tax for 0-29 days, $40 a day for 30 days or more (no sales tax); tent sites $25. Read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: Kandiyohi County 2026 Park Policy and Fees ('Green Lake County Park Daily Fees 0-29 days $42.00 plus tax; 30 PLUS Days $40.00; Tent Sites $25.00'; '(30 days or longer stays are not subject to sales tax)'), read 2026-11-11

note: Kandiyohi County park on the northeast shore of Green Lake, wooded sites set back from a swimming beach and boat access; many sites are let by the season. Off the peak summer, sites are rented by the day; from Memorial Day to Labor Day, reservations run 7 nights or more. --Claude
summary: County parks page + 2026 policy/fee PDF + ResNexus read: 61 sites (43 back-in, 16 back-in with a 90-day minimum, 7 tent), water/electric/sewer, $42 + tax a day; reservations online only and 7+ nights Memorial Day-Labor Day (no walk-up provision stated). Drop candidate on the summer minimum (Nickerson precedent). Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (minimum stay covering ordinary summer nights): 2026 Kandiyohi County Park Policy I.1, 'Reservations must be for 7 or more continuous days, except for designated tenting camp sites and Pre-Memorial Day Weekend and Post Labor Day, campsites maybe rented by the day.' and I.2 'ONLY On-Line camping reservations will be taken'. That is a 7-night minimum on every RV night from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day, the Nickerson Beach (1447) / Alcona (3996) pattern AWH dropped. No walk-up, same-day or first-come single-night provision is stated anywhere I read; the stored note's 'shorter stays FCFS' had no source, so booking.fcfs is cleared. Single nights ARE sold in spring and fall. Reviewer decides; written as a min_stay rule in case it stays.

Same policy PDF covers the other Kandiyohi County parks in the DB: Big Kandiyohi West 5612, Diamond Lake 5646, Games Lake 5648 and Big Kandiyohi East 13329 (all under the same 7-night summer rule); 5646 and 5648 also carry an unsourced fcfs 'some_sites'.

Long-stay character: 16 of 59 RV sites are 'Back-In 90 day minimum' on ResNexus; seasonal campers get the first week of booking ('For the first week of booking only, back-in campsites will be available exclusively for seasonal stays (30 days or more)'). 43 back-in sites remain for 7-night summer and nightly off-peak stays, so not mostly seasonal by count.
Season: county page says 'Open usually on fishing opener. Check with managers on dates.' No closing date published; season left as is (absent).

Waterfront: keep not waterfront. Imagery: the RV sites sit under continuous canopy north of the beach; the nearest pads (gravel spurs about 45.2721,-94.8745 and 45.2725,-94.8753) are roughly 60-90 m from the shoreline with woods between, and the shore frontage is the public beach/boat-access lot and a private dock row. No site with open ground to the water.

Website: county page OK; consider adding the ResNexus booking URL https://resnexus.com/resnexus/reservations/book/FE3B86A7-BFE2-419B-AA44-574300EC62E5 (apply.py does not write websites). Phone 320-796-5564 matches the county page.
Pin 45.27361,-94.87336 is at the park entrance on North Shore Drive, ~100-150 m from the site loops; fine.
